SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSINESS_CARD WHERE OPEN_YN = 'Y'
AND (CARD_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR COMPANY_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR DEPT_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%')

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BUSINESS_CARD C WHERE C.REGISTER = #{userNm} OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM CARD_USER U WHERE U.CARD_ID = C.CARD_ID AND U.USER_NM = #{userNm})
AND (C.CARD_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR C.COMPANY_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%' OR C.DEPT_NM LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%')
SELECT CARD_ID, CARD_NM, COMPANY_NM, DEPT_NM, POSITION_NM, TEL_NO, EMAIL, OPEN_YN, MEMO, REGISTER, REGIST_DT FROM BUSINESS_CARD WHERE CARD_ID = #{cardId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BUSINESS_CARD ( CARD_ID, CARD_NM, COMPANY_NM, DEPT_NM, POSITION_NM, TEL_NO, EMAIL, OPEN_YN, MEMO, REGIST_DT, REGISTER ) VALUES ( #{cardId}, #{cardNm}, #{companyNm}, #{deptNm}, #{positionNm}, #{telNo}, #{email}, #{openYn}, #{memo}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{register} )
mapper.update: UPDATE BUSINESS_CARD SET CARD_NM = #{cardNm}, COMPANY_NM = #{companyNm}, DEPT_NM = #{deptNm}, POSITION_NM = #{positionNm}, TEL_NO = #{telNo}, EMAIL = #{email}, OPEN_YN = #{openYn}, MEMO = #{memo}, UPDT_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, UPDUSR = #{updusr} WHERE CARD_ID = #{cardId} AND REGISTER = #{register}

MERGE INTO CARD_USER target USING (VALUES (#{cardId}, #{userNm})) source(card_id, user_nm) ON target.CARD_ID = source.card_id AND target.USER_NM = source.user_nm WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (CARD_ID, USER_NM, REGIST_DT) VALUES (source.card_id, source.user_nm, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
